fire: Crabs live on rocky shores where they can hide.

Beavers carry their food in their teeth.
Owls hunt on silent wings at night.
Otters float on their backs to feed.

Students are usually found on campus.

Pilots fly on regular routes at night.

notes: The + pole is human trafficking ('sold', 'trafficking in'), the output direction promotes 'humans'. Probes: ' their' 0.76, ' on' after Seahorses 0.45, ' for' 0.20, ' on' after Nymphs 0.19; Tourists 0.00, Sailors 0.05. Near misses swap the animal for people, so this tests animal versus human.
